subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt the conflicting cross-repository PR as source context, wait on its author, or queue a clean current-main replacement for this Feishu reply-mention bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and still present, but the original same-repository PR was closed unmerged with safety/proof blockers and the open cross-repository copy is conflicting.

options.title: Adopt or replace with a clean fix
options.body: Use the existing PRs as source context, but land a current-main OpenClaw fix with bot-specific mention evidence and scope-aware routing tests.

options.title: Wait on the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the cross-repository PR author to rebase and address the prior mention-gating and root-routing concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as a known Feishu channel bug until maintainers prioritize the channel repair.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace with a clean fix
recommendation.body: Use the existing PRs as source context, but land a current-main OpenClaw fix with bot-specific mention evidence and scope-aware routing tests.
